D5/S3/FiniteGroups/Cyclic/HalfOrderSynch.name: HalfOrderSynchronization.failure_count_le
D5/S3/FiniteGroups/Cyclic/HalfOrderSynch.signature: theorem failure_count_le {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I] {G : I → Type*} [∀ i, Group (G i)] [∀ i, Fintype (G i)] [∀ i, IsCyclic (G i)] (epsilon : ∀ i, G i) (he : ∀ i, orderOf (epsilon i) = 2) : Nat.card {x : ∀ i, G i // ¬ (Even (orderOf x) ∧ x ^ (orderOf x / 2) ≠ epsilon)} * 2 ^ (Fintype.card I - 1) ≤ Nat.card (∀ i, G i)
